facts.claim: 叙述者周五清早抵达纽约 JFK 机场 4 号航站楼 B20 登机口候机
facts.quote: early on Friday morning that I found myself at Gate B20

facts.claim: 叙述者的航班延误了一个半小时
facts.quote: My flight had been delayed an hour and a half

facts.claim: Abi Brooke 提出到犹他州机场接叙述者,叙述者以怕她迟到为由推掉,改叫出租或网约车
facts.quote: had offered to pick me up from the airport in Utah

facts.claim: 叙述者给朋友 Nicole 发短信抱怨飞机延误
叙述者没去小说区,而是走到机场书店的自助类书架前找 Genevieve Caraway 的书
facts.quote: today I went to self-help. And there she was as I knew she would be.

facts.claim: Nicole 回了一段诗,叙述者复制粘贴到谷歌,查出作者是 John Updike
facts.quote: I highlighted it, copied it, and pasted it into Google. Ah-ha. John Updike.

facts.claim: 叙述者在机场文具店花大价钱买下一支需蘸墨水的旧式钢笔,外加墨水瓶与墨盒
facts.quote: I bought an old-fashioned pen for an outrageous sum

relations.rel: Leibovitz 替 Genevieve 拍了那张著名封面照,并故意逗她笑
relations.quote: Leibovitz had made her laugh on purpose

relations.rel: 同一人:首本书署名用婚前姓 Spruce,婚后改署 Caraway
relations.quote: Originally the book’s byline read “Genevieve Spruce,”

relations.rel: Abi 是叙述者口中的未婚妻(Fuckface Fiancée),主动提出接机被婉拒
relations.quote: had offered to pick me up from the airport in Utah

relations.rel: Nicole 是获奖诗人、叙述者的朋友,两人互发短信
Denny 拒绝过叙述者,是叙述者孤独处境的由来
relations.quote: especially in the face of Denny’s rejection

numbers.claim: 叙述者航班延误的时长
numbers.quote: My flight had been delayed an hour and a half

numbers.claim: 在凤凰城中转停留的时长
numbers.quote: I had a three-hour layover in Phoenix anyway

numbers.claim: 叙述者候机的登机口编号
numbers.quote: Gate B20 of Terminal 4 at JFK Airport

numbers.claim: Genevieve Caraway 首本书出版的年份距离
numbers.quote: ubiquitous is this work that came out sixteen years ago

numbers.claim: 封面照片上 Genevieve 的年龄
numbers.quote: photo in black-and-white of the eighteen-year-old Genevieve

numbers.claim: 《纽约时报》回顾所选书封的时间跨度
numbers.quote: on the most influential book covers of the last fifty years

numbers.claim: Genevieve 首本书署名时距她遇到丈夫的时间
numbers.quote: as she was still a year away from meeting her husband
she’d published a book every three or four years

numbers.claim: 叙述者等 Nicole 回复的时长
numbers.quote: I waited a minute or two

turning_point: 叙述者在 JFK 候机时第一次主动给朋友 Nicole 发短信报备自己的情绪,并收到回信——从自认「喜欢独处」转向承认自己不愿孤独终老,伸手求联结。
notes: 1) 叙述者在本章未出现姓名,relations 里以「叙述者」代称。2) 「Denny’s rejection」只出现一句,Denny 与叙述者的具体关系(兄弟/前伴侣)本章无法确定。3) 「an outrageous sum」为模糊表述,未计入 numbers。4) 章节末只写到买钢笔,未提登机或抵达犹他。
